card.name: Space or bracket before a dose number
card.fires_on: The gap, opening bracket or slash that comes just before a number in dose and rate text. It is often right after "to", "of" or a unit, and the number follows.

modes.label: Space before a number
modes.description: The space after "to" or "of" just before a dose figure.

modes.label: Bracket before converted value
modes.description: An opening parenthesis before a second dose or rate in other units.

modes.label: Slash in counts
modes.description: A slash inside a fraction of patient counts, before the denominator.

card.plain: It fires at the small gap or bracket just before a dose or count number is written.
